New Pet Dog Regulations Implemented in Gurugram

Gurugram has introduced new regulations concerning pet dogs, making registration mandatory for dog owners. These rules cover various aspects, from the registration process to walking pets. The new framework aims to manage pet ownership within the city, with provisions for penalties for non-compliance. These regulations signify a structured approach to pet management in Gurugram.
